quote: Lisa was so kind and professional. The morning of my headshot was chaotic and I was going through a lot of personal emotions, but she found ways to help me relax and look more natural in my photos. She really took the time to calm my frazzled and flustered mood. Can’t thank her enough for her sympathy!
name: Kaija Colburn
